HEATHEN-ONLY EVENTS (HE-01 to HE-45, draft for the owner, 2026-11-23, target v1.35.98)
New Believers only. Island events about the Heathens' own lives: honoring their dead, Heathen versions of events our villagers already have, and small moments of camp life.

collection.description: A Heathen has found a shell they have never seen before: a long pink spiral that hums.

description_variants.description: An Isolan has found a shell they have never seen before: a long pink spiral that hums.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (name1) has a collection of shells that takes up most of (his/her) hut. Today (he/she) has found one (he/she) has never seen before: a long spiral, pink inside, that hums when you hold it to your ear.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: Everyone at the camp takes a turn listening to it. The children decide it is singing. The adults decide it is the sea. (name1) decides it is both.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (name1) hides it under (his/her) mat and listens to it every night before sleep. It is the best secret (he/she) has ever had.
